description: Get an X Space by ID: title, state, host and participants, and whether a replay is available. Returns raw JSON.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of JSON to return (default 50000). Longer output is cut with a [TRUNCATED] marker. Lower it to save context, raise it if you need the full response.

spaceId.description: Space ID, the letters and digits at the end of the Space URL (x.com/i/spaces/<spaceId>).

name: get_space
title: Get Space
